verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for a remote-access and team-management product, but the evidence shows no feature for setting up automations that run on their own. The Teams API 'to automate Parsec deployment' and 'API access for automation and reporting' are developer building blocks, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
